South African Reserve Bank
STATEMENT OF THE MONETARY POLICY COMMITTEE
Food price inflation has moderated faster than expected, domestic demand pressures remain subdued and international oil prices have declined.

Despite a degree of volatility, the rand exchange rate has been relatively resilient in the face of expected monetary policy tightening in some advanced economies, as well as domestic political risks and uncertainties.
Issued by Lesetja Kganyago, Governor of the South African Reserve Bank
Since the previous meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee the inflation outlook has improved.
Risks to the inflation outlook still remain.
At the same time, domestic growth prospects have deteriorated further following the surprise GDP contraction in the first quarter of 2017.
Food price inflation has moderated faster than expected, domestic demand pressures remain subdued and international oil prices have declined.
